content:
Priya: Quick runbook draft for Tuesday's 'Inference Micro-Lab' — goal: launch post + benchmark narrative + 60-min workshop. Registration page: https://redwood.ai/events/inference-micro-lab. Main asks: A) confirm Zoom recording retention B) HubSpot form mapping and lead routing C) post-event nurture 3-email flow + clips. TL;DR: keep replay gated for 14 days, push top leads to AE queue if CSAT>8 or trial-request checked. :rocket:

Sam: love it. can we gate the replay behind an email capture? yes?

Priya: yes — gated replay for 14 days, then public. we'll tag contacts with event:inference-micro-lab and source:webinar-march. HubSpot form will set property 'event_interest'='lab-inference' and 'utm_campaign' autopopulated.

Diego: Zoom settings — enable cloud recording, auto-delete off, record gallery + shared screen, enable participant SRT captions. alt host @Marta.

Marta: got it. I can be alt host. also can we turn on 'join before host' for earlier test seating?

Priya: set join_before_host=true for 15 min early, alt_host=Marta, auto_recording=cloud. add passcode? no passcode; rely on registration.

Ava: HubSpot mapping — here's JSON we need to drop into zapier/hubspot webhook:

```json
{
  "formName": "inference_micro_lab_reg",
  "mappings": {
    "email": "contact.email",
    "firstName": "contact.firstname",
    "lastName": "contact.lastname",
    "company": "company",
    "job_role": "contact.jobtitle",
    "utm_campaign": "utm_campaign",
    "event_tag": "event_inference_micro_lab",
    "lead_score_delta": "+10"
  }
}
```

Priya: perfect. also add hidden field 'benchmark_interest' so we can split registrants into 'cost' vs 'latency' cohorts for A/B messaging.

Sam: post-event sequence draft:
- 0 hr: thank you + recording link (gated)
- 24 hr: 2 min highlights + CTA: try hosted API (trial credit)
- 72 hr: benchmark deck + invite to follow-up office hours
add tags and a lead score bump on CTA clicks.

Diego: recordings — we should create 2 derivatives: full session + 3 short clips (intro, benchmark takeaways, demo). assign owners: full=Marta, clips=Sam. ensure SRT exported and uploaded to assets bucket.

Marta: I'll handle full. Sam I'll take clips. who does captions cleanup? we can use Otter + quick edit.

Ava: I'll run captions cleanup and push SRTs to /assets/events/2026/inference-micro-lab/

Priya: lead routing rules: if company size>500 OR job_role contains (Eng,ML,Platform) send to AE queue via HubSpot workflow. Also set 'follow_up_tier'='high' for attendees who clicked CTA or watched >30 min (watch time tracked via Brightcove analytics).

Sam: analytics — add UTM params on registration CTA: utm_source=twitter, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=inference_march. set event label 'bench_cohort'.

Diego: tiny ops note: enable 'recording_transcript' in Zoom settings so we get JSON transcripts for snippet generation.

Priya: checklist for go-time (Tuesday 10am PT):
- [ ] Zoom scheduled with alt host and cloud recording
- [ ] HubSpot form live + test submission
- [ ] Registration page variants A/B ready
- [ ] Slack webhook for new registrants -> #marketing-leads
- [ ] Clips owners briefed
- [ ] Post-event email templates ready

Marta: I'll verify Zoom + test recording at 9:30am.

Sam: I'll run test form and confirm HubSpot property mapping at 9:40am.

Ava: I'll make sure captions export pipeline is live.

Priya: last bit — messaging: opening launch post copy (short): "Join our Inference Micro-Lab: live cost vs latency benchmark, demos & Q&A. Register for a 60-min hands-on session." We'll A/B test headline vs 'Real-world inference benchmarks: cost, latency & tradeoffs'.

Sam: social copy ready, I'll queue variations in Buffer.

Diego: Zoom reminder bot — set to send 24hr & 1hr reminders. also schedule post-event auto-export of recording to assets and trigger HubSpot 'Attended' update.

Priya: thanks team. ping here when tests pass. :thumbsup:

HubSpotBot: Test submission received: priya+test@redwood.ai — mapped fields ok.

Priya: green across the board. see you Tuesday.
